review:
Grug Make Fire is a 5x4 prehistoric payline slot about a caveman, dinosaurs and the discovery of fire. Burning symbols set fire to their reel above where they land. Burnt low-paying symbols turn into another special symbol, and burnt high-paying symbols become Burnt Multipliers that add their value to every win they're part of.

Each high-paying symbol has its own burnt multiplier, so a burning reel full of premium symbols is the best outcome. In the top bonus, the Wildfire Bar is progressive and climbs through levels as the round continues. The cap is 10,000x in every mode.
